summary: ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting its first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The filing includes highlights such as parcel volume growth of 13.2% year-over-year, adjusted net income of RMB2.4 billion, and an adjustment to the conversion price of its 0.925% convertible bonds due 2031. There are no special-situation events like acquisitions, divestitures, or restructurings. This is a routine earnings report with no transaction, activist campaign, or strategic review. The adjustment to convertible bond terms is a standard operational update. Risk-arb or special-situation analysis is not applicable.
